result.instructions: Tools for Microkeeper, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is rostered at our Melbourne site next week?"; "Which staff have leave requests in the next month?"; "Show the timesheets for the last 7 days for all staff.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Microkeeper data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run microkeeper_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run microkeeper_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run microkeeper_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. microkeeper_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: microkeeper_get_employees
tools.title: Get employees
tools.description: Read staff profiles. Give changed_since (yyyy-mm-dd, up to a year back) for everyone changed since then, or ids with id_type for specific staff. With neither, returns all active staff. Action get_employees (HR/Staff, Read Only).

changed_since.description: Staff changed on or after this date.

id_type.description: The kind of ID in ids.

ids.description: Staff IDs of the kind in id_type.

tools.name: microkeeper_get_group_config
tools.title: Get groups
tools.description: Read the account's Groups (teams and sites that staff belong to). Action get_group_config (HR/Staff, Read Only).

tools.name: microkeeper_get_locations
tools.title: Get locations
tools.description: Read every Location (site) with its LID, third_ID, address, active flag and managers. Action get_locations (Account, Read Only).

tools.name: microkeeper_get_roles
tools.title: Get roles
tools.description: Read every Role (active and inactive) with its ROID and required skills. Action get_roles (Account, Read Only).

tools.name: microkeeper_get_jobs
tools.title: Get jobs
tools.description: Read Jobs (projects, sites or functions staff clock to). Give JID or JobID lists for specific Jobs; otherwise status all or finished. Action get_jobs (Account, Read Only).

status.description: Default "all" (every Job that is not finished).

tools.name: microkeeper_get_roster
tools.title: Get roster
tools.description: Read rostered shifts for every employee at active Locations, for up to 31 days (inclusive). Action get_roster (Roster, Read Only).

tools.name: microkeeper_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheets
tools.description: Read worked shifts for up to 31 days (inclusive), for all staff or the usernames given. Action get_timesheet (Roster, Read Only).

eusernames.description: Microkeeper usernames. Leave out for all staff.

tools.name: microkeeper_get_leave
tools.title: Get leave requests
tools.description: Read leave requests that start, end or run through a date range: type, dates and status. Action get_leave (Payroll, Read Only).

tools.name: microkeeper_upsert_employees
tools.title: Add or update employees
tools.description: Add new staff or update existing ones (matched by EmployeeID, then eusername, then EID). Only the fields you send change. A new employee gets a login email only if you set welcome. Action upsert_employees (HR/Staff, Read/Write).

EmployeeID.description: Your software's ID for the person. A known ID updates; a new ID adds.

firstname.description: Required on every employee, updates included.

lastname.description: Required on every employee, updates included.

email.description: Changing it asks the employee to verify the new address.

phoneno.description: Changing it asks the employee to verify the new number.

tools.name: microkeeper_upsert_locations
tools.title: Add or update locations
tools.description: Add Locations or update them (matched by LID, or by third_ID). Locations you do not send stay as they are. Action upsert_locations (Account, Read/Write).

LID.description: Microkeeper's Location ID. A known LID updates; 0 with a new third_ID adds.

third_ID.description: Your software's ID for the Location.

tools.name: microkeeper_update_jobs
tools.title: Add or update jobs
tools.description: Add Jobs or update them (matched by JobID, or by JID; JID 0 adds). Jobs you do not send are not changed. Action update_jobs (Account, Read/Write).

JobID.description: Your software's ID for the Job.

JID.description: Microkeeper's Job ID. 0 adds a Job.

prompts.title: Get started with Microkeeper
prompts.description: What you can do with Microkeeper here, with example requests to try.
